name: tyrosine 3-monooxygenase/tryptophan 5-monooxygenase activation protein epsilon

function.text: YWHAE encodes 14-3-3 protein epsilon. Annotated molecular activities include protein heterodimerization activity and protein sequestering activity. It participates in signal transduction and intracellular signal transduction.

function.text: YWHAE encodes 14-3-3 protein epsilon. Based in part on similarity, it is an adapter protein implicated in the regulation of a large spectrum of both general and specialized signaling pathways. It binds to a large number of partners, usually by recognition of a phosphoserine or phosphothreonine motif. It positively regulates phosphorylated protein HSF1 nuclear export to the cytoplasm.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving YWHAE have been reported in endometrial stromal sarcoma, clear cell sarcoma of kidney, and sarcoma with BCOR genetic alterations.
